name: Native Postman-style API tester for iOS and Mac

mentions.name: Native Postman-style API tester for iOS and Mac
mentions.description: This native iOS and Mac app provides Postman-style API testing in a lightweight package that reaches feature parity at around 4 MB. It adds iCloud sync and MCP support so test suites can be controlled from Claude on a Mac, and is being released publicly this week.
mentions.problem: Postman is a resource hog, frustrating its users.
mentions.audience: Others who are feeling done with Postman and want an alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Got tired of postman being such a resource hog, so I made a native app that does much same thing for iOS and Mac.

Eventually reached parity at around 4mb and added iCloud synch and mcp so I can control my test suites from Claude on my Mac.

Making  it available for others to use this week after seeing a lot of people are also feeling done with postman
